fix.headline: Denman's close: 'go and sin no more'
fix.digest: Resuming on 25 October, Denman ended his summing-up with Christ's words to the woman taken in adultery. To many hearers the words seemed to concede guilt: C. C. Western, writing to Creevey from Brighton four days later, criticised the close, and it was mocked in verse and print for weeks after. His comparison of the King to Nero, which Creevey praised, had come the day before.
